description: This dataset provides information on the distribution of the fish species Macolor niger, also known as the black snapper. It includes records from various locations around the world, with a focus on countries like Australia, Egypt, and Indonesia. The data covers taxonomic details, geographic coordinates, and observation dates, making it useful for studying the habitat and range of this species. The dataset's semantic profile indicates that it is well-structured for biodiversity research, with clear classifications and measurements. Researchers can use this data to analyze the distribution patterns of Macolor niger, track its presence in different regions, and understand its ecological preferences. The information can also support conservation efforts and inform fisheries management practices.
